## Exportando os dados do `ODK Collect`

`readInstancesXML()`

 Extract data from ODK Collect instance XMLs (without ODK Briefcase)
 Reads all submission XMLs stored under an ODK Collect `instances/`
 directory and returns them as a named list of data frames (one per
 repeat level).
 
```{r }

library(odkTreeCensus)

instDir <- "/home/aao/Ale2026/AleProjetos/Rpackages/odkExportDataTest/test01/instances"
eDir <- "/home/aao/Ale2026/AleProjetos/Rpackages/odkExportDataTest/exportedData"
base <- "testeA00"
mediaDir <- "/home/aao/Ale2026/AleProjetos/Rpackages/odkExportDataTest/exportedData"

readInstancesXML(instancesDir = instDir, expDir = eDir, mediaOutDir = mediaDir)


```
